title: aquilegia formosa var. hypolasia
intro: Aquilegia formosa var. hypolasia, commonly known as the Western red columbine, is a plant species in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of the Western red columbine are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, reducing congestion and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Aquilegia formosa var. hypolasia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
